en.tagline: Generate images, video, 3D and audio on Higgsfield AI
en.summary: This skill submits generation jobs to Higgsfield AI models through the higgsfield CLI. It covers image, video, 3D, and audio generation, plus Marketing Studio ads and Virality Predictor video scoring. It picks a default model for each task so you can ask for an asset in plain language.
problem: Generating media on Higgsfield means choosing among many models, looking up model IDs, and passing the right media and parameter flags. Each model has its own schema and inputs.

With this skill, the agent picks a sensible default model for the request, accepts local file paths or UUIDs for media, and waits for the job to finish. You get back the result URL and a one-line summary.
fit: Generating images, videos, 3D models, or audio from a text prompt or reference files
Making ads, UGC videos, or product demos with Marketing Studio
Scoring a finished video's hook, attention, and retention with Virality Predictor
unfit: Brand identity, brandbooks, or Soul training (use the other Higgsfield skills)
YouTube thumbnails, explainer videos, text-to-speech, or playable game assets
steps: The agent picks a default model based on the request, such as GPT Image 2.6 for images or Seedance 2.5 for video.
Media inputs are passed straight to flags as a local file path or a UUID, and the CLI uploads local files automatically.
If the parameters are unclear, the agent checks the model schema once with `higgsfield model get` and passes only what is needed.
The job is submitted with `higgsfield generate create` and `--wait`, so the command blocks until the result is ready.
The agent returns the primary result URL with a one-line summary of the model and duration.
For Virality Predictor, the agent returns the scores, an interpretation, and the Open report link.

zh.tagline: 用 Higgsfield 生成图片、视频、3D 与音频
zh.summary: 这个技能通过 higgsfield 命令行工具，向 Higgsfield AI 的模型提交生成任务。它覆盖图片、视频、3D 和音频生成，还包括 Marketing Studio 广告和 Virality Predictor 视频评分。每类任务都有默认模型，你可以用自然语言直接描述需求。
problem: 在 Higgsfield 上生成素材时，需要在众多模型中选择，查找模型 ID，并正确传入媒体和参数。每个模型的参数结构都不同。
使用这个技能后，智能体会为请求选择合适的默认模型，接受本地文件路径或 UUID 作为素材输入，并等待任务完成。你拿到的是结果链接和一句话摘要。
fit: 根据文字描述或参考文件生成图片、视频、3D 模型或音频
用 Marketing Studio 制作广告、UGC 视频或产品演示
用 Virality Predictor 评估成片的开场钩子、注意力和留存
unfit: 品牌形象、品牌手册或 Soul 训练（请使用其他 Higgsfield 技能）
YouTube 缩略图、讲解视频、文本转语音或可玩游戏素材
steps: 智能体根据需求选择默认模型，例如图片用 GPT Image 2.6，视频用 Seedance 2.5。
媒体输入直接通过参数传入，可以是本地文件路径或 UUID，本地文件由命令行工具自动上传。
如果参数不明确，智能体会先用 `higgsfield model get` 查看一次模型参数，只传入需要的内容。
智能体使用 `higgsfield generate create` 并加上 `--wait` 提交任务，命令会等待到结果生成完成。
智能体返回主要结果链接，并附一句话说明模型和时长。
使用 Virality Predictor 时，智能体返回评分、解读和 Open report 链接。
